name: 33777 · Seminole, FL
findings: ZIP 33777 (Seminole) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33777 (Seminole) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33777 (Seminole) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
